hero.description: The Milwaukee-Downer "Quad" NRHP on the campus of UW-Milwaukee , at the corner of Hartford and Downer. This view is looking north at Merrill Hall (architect Howland Russel), with Johnston Hall (architect Alexander C. Eschweiler ) to the right. Holton Hall is out of view to the left. Taken with a Canon PowerShot SD850 IS on April 25, 2009.
